about: Ordered patterns that map AWS CLI stderr to one error class; the first match wins and no match is unknown. A pattern with operations applies only to those calls (service operation). absent is the only class that allows a create, so each absent pattern is the exact not-found message of the calls it names: only Could not find endpoint means an endpoint is absent.

classes.credentials: Stop every mutating call, poll the caller identity, and tell the user to sign in again
classes.absent: The named resource does not exist
classes.quota: An account limit refused the request
classes.capacity: AWS has no machine for the request right now
classes.busy: The resource is in a state that refuses the change until it ends
classes.conflict: A resource of that name already exists
classes.transient: The call may or may not have reached AWS; ask again
classes.invalid: AWS refused the request as malformed or unsupported
